description: Enables Bookmark blocks in TmNotionEditor. When the user pastes a URL into a bookmark block, the editor calls this provider to fetch Open Graph metadata (title, description, image). Without this provider the bookmark block shows a plain URL link.

methods.name: ResolveBookmarkAsync
methods.description: Fetches Open Graph / meta tags for the given URL and returns the resolved metadata.

examples.title: Simple server-side OG resolver
